summary: Madison Air Solutions Corp, via its German subsidiary, entered a Sale and Purchase Agreement on 2026-08-15 to acquire ebm-papst Mulfingen GmbH and related entities from Sturm Beteiligungs, Ziehl Beteiligungen, and Philippiak Holding. The transaction values the target at EUR 4,775.0 million enterprise price, with a base price of EUR 4,367.0 million and estimated cash closing at EUR 4,412.0 million. A locked-box mechanism applies from March 31, 2026, with leakage adjustments; the deal is expected to close by December 31, 2026. Watch for regulatory approvals and financing conditions in Germany/EU.
